title: Edit Distance
desc:
給你兩個單詞 word1 和 word2，請返回將 word1 轉換成 word2 所使用的最少操作數。

你可以對一個單詞進行如下三種操作：

  • 插入一個字符
  • 刪除一個字符
  • 替換一個字符
constraints: word1 和 word2 由小寫英文字母組成

class Solution:
    def minDistance(self, word1: str, word2: str) -> int:

solutions.python:
class Solution:
    def minDistance(self, word1: str, word2: str) -> int:
        """
        方法：動態規劃
        時間複雜度: O(m * n)
        空間複雜度: O(m * n)
        """
        m, n = len(word1), len(word2)
        
        # 創建 DP 表格
        dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
        
        # 初始化：空字串轉換
        for i in range(m + 1):
            dp[i][0] = i  # 刪除 i 個字符
        for j in range(n + 1):
            dp[0][j] = j  # 插入 j 個字符
        
        # 填充 DP 表格
        for i in range(1, m + 1):
            for j in range(1, n + 1):
                if word1[i-1] == word2[j-1]:
                    # 字符相同，不需要操作
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]
                else:
                    # 取三種操作的最小值
                    insert = dp[i][j-1] + 1      # 插入
                    delete = dp[i-1][j] + 1      # 刪除
                    replace = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1   # 替換
                    dp[i][j] = min(insert, delete, replace)
        
        return dp[m][n]
    
    def minDistance_optimized(self, word1: str, word2: str) -> int:
        """
        空間優化版本
        時間複雜度: O(m * n)
        空間複雜度: O(n)
        """
        m, n = len(word1), len(word2)
        
        # 只保存一行
        prev = list(range(n + 1))
        
        for i in range(1, m + 1):
            curr = [i]  # 當前行的第一個元素
            for j in range(1, n + 1):
                if word1[i-1] == word2[j-1]:
                    curr.append(prev[j-1])
                else:
                    curr.append(min(
                        curr[j-1] + 1,    # 插入
                        prev[j] + 1,      # 刪除
                        prev[j-1] + 1     # 替換
                    ))
            prev = curr
        
        return prev[n]
    
    def minDistance_1d(self, word1: str, word2: str) -> int:
        """
        進一步優化：原地更新
        """
        m, n = len(word1), len(word2)
        dp = list(range(n + 1))
        
        for i in range(1, m + 1):
            prev = dp[0]
            dp[0] = i
            for j in range(1, n + 1):
                temp = dp[j]
                if word1[i-1] == word2[j-1]:
                    dp[j] = prev
                else:
                    dp[j] = min(dp[j-1], dp[j], prev) + 1
                prev = temp
        
        return dp[n]
